d:
The Grizzlies defeated the Warriors, 126-98 tonight in Memphis. Jaylen Wells finished with a team-high 22 points along with 7 rebounds and 4 three pointers for the Grizzlies, while Cedric Coward tallied 19 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds in the game. Charles Bassey recorded 16 points, 2 blocks and 13 rebounds. The Grizzlies improve their record to 12-4 with the win, while the Warriors fall to 8-8 for the season.
